title: Keep unfulfilled or conflicted contract heads blocking
preconditions: Use separate isolated fixtures with the same dependency pinned to a uniquely current handoff v1: one proposed, one accepted, and one produced by merging branches with competing fulfilled and violated lifecycle heads.

steps.action: Evaluate the consumer dependency in each fixture using work-items/readiness queries.
steps.expected_result: Proposed/accepted contracts are unsatisfied; competing lifecycle heads remain conflicted and do not satisfy the gate.

steps.action: In the conflicted fixture reconcile all lifecycle parents to one fulfilled event using supported authoring once available; query again.
steps.expected_result: Only the single fulfilled head at the still-current v1 opens the dependency.

expected_result: Neither an incomplete lifecycle nor one fulfilled competitor opens dependent work.
